scope: Operating-pattern and industry capability research; planning only.

sources.title: Business Model Canvas
sources.supports: Business models cover several linked dimensions, including channels, activities, revenue and costs.

sources.title: CRM, documentation source 19.0
sources.supports: CRM concerns leads, opportunities and sales activity, distinct from a contacts-only slice.

sources.title: Project, documentation source 19.0
sources.supports: Projects group tasks and activities; profitability is a separate concern to validate.

sources.title: Appointments, documentation source 19.0
sources.supports: Scheduling can depend on users/resources, capacity and timezone.

sources.title: Creating field-service tasks, source 19.0
sources.supports: Field-service work is represented by tasks and can connect to sales/helpdesk workflows.

sources.title: Rental, documentation source 19.0
sources.supports: Rental includes quotations, reservation, pickup/return and invoicing.

sources.title: Rental product types, source 19.0
sources.supports: Rental goods/services have different handling; integrations and nightly periods are documented.

sources.title: Restaurant, documentation source 19.0
sources.supports: Restaurant POS models floors/tables and restaurant-specific service flow.

sources.title: Commerce modules
sources.supports: Commerce workflows compose product, inventory, cart and other module services.

sources.title: Module isolation
sources.supports: Modules own resources; cross-module features use explicit composition boundaries.

sources.title: Module links
sources.supports: Cross-module associations are modeled explicitly without direct module ownership transfer.

sources.title: Reservations lifecycle
sources.supports: Inventory reservations hold quantities associated with order fulfillment.

sources.title: Order transactions
sources.supports: Order transactions reference payment/refund records; payment processing belongs to the payment module.

sources.title: Accept payment flow
sources.supports: Payment sessions are authorized with a third-party payment provider.

sources.title: Sales Order
sources.supports: Orders connect confirmed commercial terms with downstream delivery, invoice and payment steps.

sources.title: Project
sources.supports: Projects have tasks, planned dates, status and operational tracking.

sources.title: Manufacturing
sources.supports: Manufacturing includes workstations, job cards, BOMs and work orders.

sources.title: Bill Of Materials
sources.supports: BOM records materials/subassemblies and may include production operations.

sources.title: Immutable Ledger
sources.supports: Posted stock/accounting history uses traceable reversals/corrections instead of silent replacement.

sources.title: How subscriptions work
sources.supports: Recurring subscriptions have status transitions, invoice/payment lifecycle and provisioning concerns.

sources.title: Basic usage-based billing
sources.supports: Usage-based pricing uses measured usage; the reviewed page distinguishes current integration approaches.

sources.title: Connect
sources.supports: Platform/marketplace payments involve several accounts and movement of funds between parties.

sources.title: Program Enrollment
sources.supports: Enrollment connects a student, program/courses and academic term.

sources.title: Student Portal
sources.supports: Student-facing schedule, grades, attendance and fee history are distinct domain views.

sources.title: Fees
sources.supports: Fee records relate to student/program enrollment and academic periods.

sources.title: FHIR R5 Patient
sources.supports: Patient is a healthcare resource with its own identity and domain relationships.

sources.title: OPERA Cloud 25.3 Room Management
sources.supports: Hotel operations include housekeeping, room status and out-of-service/out-of-order handling.

sources.title: OPERA Cloud 26.4 Bookings
sources.supports: Hospitality reservations span properties and several reservation categories.

sources.title: Donation
sources.supports: Donor/donation records link to payment entries; fundraising is a distinct workflow.

sources.title: Ticket
sources.supports: Service tickets have status, priority, routing and conditional SLA lifecycle.

sources.title: Handle Notifications
sources.supports: Notification verification uses signatures/status checks; duplicate handling must be idempotent.

sources.title: API access scopes
sources.supports: External API operations require the applicable resource access scopes.
